title: odontites litoralis
intro: Odontites litoralis, commonly known as Coastal Toothwort, is a type of flowering plant in the borage family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Odontites litoralis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and heal skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antiseptic, astringent, and expectorant, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
